decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on applying early pressure with aggressive creatures and disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also includes powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to maintain a strong board presence. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive strategy with utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Den of the Bugbear. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with a mix of efficient removal and hard-hitting creatures.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value, dealing damage through Mayhem Devil triggers and using Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven combo to maintain board presence. It also includes some disruption with Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's plays. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional mana ramp and flexibility. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and resource management, utilizing various sacrifice outlets and synergistic cards to create a powerful board state.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with a mix of Azorius tempo control elements and Spirit creatures. By utilizing efficient creatures like Rattlechains and Mausoleum Wanderer, along with disruptive cards like Spell Queller and Shacklegeist, the deck aims to control the board while also constantly applying pressure to the opponent. Cards like Curious Obsession provide card draw and help maintain tempo advantage, while cards like Supreme Phantom buff up Spirit creatures. Overall, the strategy is to maintain a fast and aggressive pace while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counter magic, removal spells, and card draw until the player is able to establish a dominant position on the battlefield. Using powerful spells like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Doomskar, along with efficient creatures like Dream Trawler and Strict Proctor, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up for a game-winning play. The land base provides flexibility and consistency, allowing the player to access the necessary mana to cast their spells and activate powerful abilities.

The strategy of the deck revolves around using Enigmatic Incarnation to transform creatures into powerful enchantments and control the board with a variety of removal spells and disruptive creatures. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while generating value from its own creatures and enchantments. The addition of Keruga, the Macrosage as a companion provides additional card draw and a larger starting hand size, giving the deck more consistency and resilience in longer games. The inclusion of various powerful creatures and enchantments allows the deck to adapt to different situations and outvalue the opponent over time.

This deck focuses on using ramp and control elements to accelerate mana production and disrupt opponent's strategies. With cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Bring to Light, the deck aims to quickly cast powerful spells and overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Chained to the Rocks helps control the board, while Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana flexibility. The deck also includes unique card selections like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to further enhance its control and ramp strategies.

The deck revolves around using Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing for explosive combo plays. It aims to quickly ramp up mana through Thespian's Stage, Hidden Strings, and other cards, while also utilizing cards like Pore Over the Pages and Behold the Beyond for card advantage. The deck also includes various utility lands and cards like Dark Petition and Mastermind's Acquisition to search for key combo pieces. The goal is to control the board and search for key cards to pull off a game-winning combo.

The deck revolves around the concept of quickly assembling the combo pieces needed to generate a large amount of mana using Lotus Field, combined with cards like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to untap it multiple times. This allows for explosive plays, such as casting Omniscience or Emergent Ultimatum, which can provide a huge advantage or win the game outright. The deck includes various card selection and tutoring effects to find the key pieces needed to execute the combo efficiently while also providing some flexibility in terms of answers to opposing strategies.

The main concept of this deck is to establish early board presence with efficient creatures like Rattlechains, Mausoleum Wanderer, and Shacklegeist while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Lofty Denial and Spell Queller. By utilizing cards like Curious Obsession and Spectral Sailor, the deck aims to maintain card advantage and apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Azorius tempo cards like Brazen Borrower and Otawara, Soaring City helps to control the tempo of the game and outmaneuver the opponent. This deck focuses on a fast-paced, aggressive approach while maintaining tempo and control.

The key concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly and efficiently establish a strong board presence with low-cost creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves. The deck utilizes the combo potential of Collected Company to dig for additional creatures and gain value from the enter-the-battlefield abilities of cards like Skyclave Apparition and Bishop of Wings. The deck aims to deal damage early and often, leveraging the lifelink and angel synergies provided by Resplendent Angel and Righteous Valkyrie. The deck also includes some utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire, as well as a few high-impact creatures like Sigarda, Font of Blessings.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces of Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful synergy that dominates the battlefield. Utilizing cards like Grisly Salvage, Vessel of Nascency, and Traverse the Ulvenwald to find the necessary pieces quickly, while disruption through cards like Thoughtseize and Duress keeps the opponent off balance. The deck also includes support cards like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot to maintain board presence and generate advantage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful combination of creatures and planeswalkers.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of Enigmatic Incarnation and Fires of Invention to cheat in powerful creatures like Koma, Cosmos Serpent and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also utilizes Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while employing a versatile range of lands and spells to ensure consistent mana production and card advantage. By combining strong control elements with potent threats, this deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and establish dominance over the battlefield.

The deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful enchantments and creatures to control the game. The key strategy involves ramping up mana quickly with Fires of Invention and utilizing Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also leverages powerful creatures like Dragonlord Atarka, Tolsimir, Friend to Wolves, and Koma, Cosmos Serpent, along with support from touch the Spirit Realm and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain board control and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of powerful legendary creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse adds additional versatility and threats to the deck.

The main idea of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, in order to drop powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also utilizes cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival to generate card advantage and maintain board presence. Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility and protection. Overall, the focus is on aggressively building up green mana devotion and overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It includes powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Graveyard Trespasser to deal damage quickly, while also including disruption in the form of cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and remove threats. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Misery's Shadow to close out games. By combining fast creatures, removal, and game-ending threats, this deck aims to win quickly and decisively.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create powerful combo interactions. It aims to control the board with cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil while also ramping up for the combo with cards like Grisly Salvage and Traverse the Ulvenwald. The inclusion of Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot provides additional threats and value. The deck also includes some disruption with Duress and Witherbloom Command. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling the combo pieces and overwhelming the opponent with powerful synergies.
